{{{{{1|Monster Infobox}}} |title = Corrupt Spirit |images = Corrupt Spirit Anim.gif |location = [[Iridium Quarry]] |drops = ''See loot table'' |hp = 2000 |dmg = 90 |def = 3 |speed = 4 |XP = 20 }} ''{{PAGENAME}}'' is a type of [[Monsters|Monster]] found specifically in the [[Iridium Quarry]] off the [[Crimson Badlands]]. How many spawn per day depends on the [[Configuration Options]] chosen: * Default: 5 - 30 per day, spawning in waves of 3 with 30 in-game minutes between spawns * ChallengingBadlands: 5 - 55 per day, spawning in waves of 3 with 30 in-game minutes between spawns ==Strategy== {{PAGENAME}} exhibits the same behavior as a Carbon Ghost. It hovers and floats towards the player and is susceptible to knockback. {{Note|For clarity on vanilla behavior and strategy, see [[Stardew:Carbon Ghost|Stardew Valley Wiki - Carbon Ghost]].}} ==Loot Drops== {{LootDropsTable|Title=Corrupt Spirit}} | rowspan="4" | [[Iridium Quarry]] | {{Name|Void Pebble}} || 1 |- | {{NameSDV|Solar Essence}} || 1 - 4 |- | {{NameSDV|Void Essence}} || 0 - 2 |- | {{Name|Void Delight}} || 1 ✦ |} ✦ Not all instances of Corrupt Spirit carry the chance to drop Void Delight. The single instance of the monster that carries the drop has a 70% chance to spawn per day. {{clear}}
